# The back wall: 10 m wide, 4.5 m tall at world z -2.2, a dark skirting band along its foot. Up Z.
new
material new Wall --base-color 0.2627 0.0000 0.4039 --no-slot
material new Skirt --base-color 0.5804 0.1294 0.4157 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Wall --size 1 --location 0.000 2.250 2.400
scale 10.000 0.100 3.600
apply --scale
material assign Wall
add mesh cube --name Skirt --size 1 --location 0.000 2.170 0.300
scale 10.000 0.080 0.600
apply --scale
material assign Skirt
select all
shade flat
export wall.glb
